judge.system: You label screenshots from original Xbox games running in an emulator. Reply with one word.
judge.ask: Is the player in control of gameplay in this screenshot? Answer INGAME if it shows gameplay: the game world with the player's character, vehicle, cursor or pieces under the player's control, usually with a HUD (score, health, map, speedometer, ammo, timer), including a pause menu drawn over gameplay. Answer OTHER for anything else: black or blank screens, logos, legal or warning screens, videos and cutscenes (including in-engine scenes with letterbox bars or no HUD), title screens, menus, character, car or level selection, profile and save prompts, loading screens and briefings. Answer with one word: INGAME or OTHER.
